title: GTFS Transit & Realtime API Specification
description: Comprehensive reference of all available GTFS transit, hierarchy search, routing, stops, trips, agencies, and realtime feeds APIs with practical use case scenarios.

apis.summary: List available region databases and their transit modes
apis.description: Discovers and lists all GTFS SQLite databases available in the environment with their unique identifier, name, database file, and available transit modes (rail, ferry, bus, tram, subway, etc.).

scenarios.name: List All Discovered Regions
scenarios.description: Retrieve all dynamically detected country/region databases along with their available transit modes (e.g. bus, rail, ferry, tram).

apis.summary: Spatial bounds and metadata of all regions
apis.description: Returns geographic bounding boxes (min/max lat/lon), center points, total stops, and route counts for all detected SQLite databases.

scenarios.name: Inspect Spatial Coverage Across All Regions
scenarios.description: Fetch bounding box coordinates and stop counts for all country databases to configure map boundaries.

apis.summary: Hierarchical active routes search from coordinates
apis.description: Finds active transit lines near coordinates. Checks 500m radius first; if no routes are active/found, cascades automatically to city (15km), state (60km), and nationwide country levels.

parameters.name: route_type
parameters.description: Filter by GTFS route_type (e.g. 2 for Train/Rail, 3 for Bus, 0 for Tram)

scenarios.name: Level 1 (500m Radius Match)
scenarios.description: Search active lines around Amsterdam Central Station within the default 500m radius.

scenarios.name: Level 2 (City-Level Fallback)
scenarios.description: Search coordinates in rural or suburban outskirts where 500m has no stops, cascading to the wider city area.

scenarios.name: Region Override With Route Type Filter (Trains Only)
scenarios.description: Lock search to netherlands-gtfs database and return rail routes only (route_type=2).

scenarios.name: Custom Initial Radius (1000m)
scenarios.description: Expand initial radius to 1,000 meters before initiating city-level fallback.

apis.summary: Hierarchical active stops or routes search
apis.description: Hierarchical active search cascading 500m -> city -> state -> country. Allows toggling response type between routes (default) and stops.

parameters.name: group_parent
parameters.description: Group platform stops under parent stations

scenarios.name: Hierarchical Search for Stops
scenarios.description: Display active physical transit stops present in the hierarchy around coordinates.

scenarios.name: Hierarchical Search for Routes (Default)
scenarios.description: Display active routes with deduplicated headsigns present in the hierarchy.

scenarios.name: Hierarchical Stops with Platform Ungrouping
scenarios.description: Return individual platform stops rather than grouping under parent stations (group_parent=false).

apis.summary: Browse, filter and search transit routes
apis.description: Paginated route catalog supporting text search, agency filtering, route type filtering, region locking, and terminal stop metadata.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text matching route short/long name or destination

scenarios.name: Paginated Route Listing
scenarios.description: Fetch first page of 5 routes with total route count.

scenarios.name: Target Specific Region Database
scenarios.description: Retrieve routes strictly from the Netherlands GTFS database.

scenarios.name: Search Routes by Name / Keyword
scenarios.description: Search routes matching keyword 'Sprinter'.

scenarios.name: Filter Routes by Transit Operator (Agency)
scenarios.description: Filter lines operated specifically by Nederlandse Spoorwegen (IFF:ns).

scenarios.name: Filter by Transit Mode (Trains Only: route_type=2)
scenarios.description: Filter lines to train/rail transport mode.

scenarios.name: Combined Search (Region + Agency + Keyword + Pagination)
scenarios.description: Search 'Intercity' lines by NS within Netherlands GTFS on page 2.

apis.summary: Active routes within coordinate radius
apis.description: Queries stops within radius meters, finds active scheduled routes servicing those stops, and returns route details sorted by distance.

scenarios.name: Routes within 500m of Station
scenarios.description: Find top 3 closest routes serving Amsterdam Centraal within 500m radius.

scenarios.name: Expanded Radius (2,000m) with Region Override
scenarios.description: Search routes within a 2km radius locked to netherlands-gtfs.

apis.summary: Currently active / running routes by service calendar
apis.description: Checks GTFS calendar, calendar_dates, and trip schedules to return lines currently operating at the specified timestamp.

scenarios.name: Live Active Routes (Right Now)
scenarios.description: Fetch routes currently running right now in the network.

scenarios.name: Active Routes at Specific Date & Time
scenarios.description: Check which routes are scheduled to run at a specific historical or future date/time.

apis.summary: Detailed route profile and metadata
apis.description: Returns full route details (name, short name, vehicle mode, agency, start/end terminal stops, stop count, trip count, headsigns). Accepts region, region_id, or regionId; auto-detects the containing database if omitted.

scenarios.name: UAE Route Details (with regionId)
scenarios.description: Fetch details for UAE line 101 specifying regionId=uae.

scenarios.name: UAE Route Details (Auto-Detect without region)
scenarios.description: Fetch details for UAE line 101 with auto-detection across databases.

apis.summary: Ordered stops served by a route
apis.description: Returns the complete sequence of physical stops served by a given route, ordered by stop_sequence for outbound and inbound directions.

scenarios.name: Stops Sequence for Route 17803
scenarios.description: Retrieve all stops called by Sprinter line 17803 in sequence.

scenarios.name: UAE Route Stops (with regionId)
scenarios.description: Fetch ordered stops for UAE line 101 specifying regionId=uae.

scenarios.name: UAE Route Stops (Auto-Detect without region)
scenarios.description: Fetch ordered stops for UAE line 101 with automatic database detection.

apis.summary: Full timetable and schedule for a route
apis.description: Returns scheduled trip departures across calendar service days for a route.

scenarios.name: Route 17803 Complete Timetable
scenarios.description: View scheduled departure times and trip IDs for route 17803.

scenarios.name: UAE Route Timetable / Schedule (with regionId)
scenarios.description: Fetch today's scheduled departures for UAE line 101 specifying regionId=uae.

apis.summary: Shape geometries and polylines for a route
apis.description: Returns shape points (latitude, longitude, sequence) for rendering route paths on Leaflet, Mapbox, or Google Maps.

scenarios.name: Fetch Map Polyline Coordinates for Route 17803
scenarios.description: Get map line geometry for route 17803.

apis.summary: Next upcoming departures for a route
apis.description: Upcoming departure times for a route from the current time.

scenarios.name: Next 5 Departures for Route 17803
scenarios.description: Get upcoming departures for route 17803.

apis.summary: Find transit stops near coordinates
apis.description: Finds stops within radius meters, computes distance from user coordinates, and lists active routes calling at each stop.

scenarios.name: Stops within 500m of Coordinates
scenarios.description: Find closest 5 stops near Amsterdam Centraal.

scenarios.name: Custom 1km Search with Region
scenarios.description: Find stops in a 1,000m radius specifically in netherlands-gtfs.

apis.summary: Stops within map viewport bounding box
apis.description: Queries all stops located within specified latitude/longitude bounding box for dynamic map viewport loading.

scenarios.name: Map Viewport Query (Amsterdam Center)
scenarios.description: Fetch stops within bounding box of central Amsterdam.

apis.summary: Routes servicing a specific stop
apis.description: Lists all transit lines and routes calling at a given stop identifier.

scenarios.name: Lines Calling at Stop 2992191 (Amsterdam Centraal)
scenarios.description: Retrieve all lines that call at Amsterdam Centraal stop ID 2992191.

apis.summary: Stop arrival / departure event timeline
apis.description: Chronological events timeline for a stop across all trips.

scenarios.name: Chronological Events at Stop 2992191
scenarios.description: View next 10 arrival/departure events at Amsterdam Centraal.

apis.summary: Paginated GTFS stop catalog
apis.description: Full stops table search and export, with optional filtering by agency.

scenarios.name: Search Stops by Name
scenarios.description: Search for stops with 'Centraal' in their name.

apis.summary: Live / upcoming departures across all nearby stops
apis.description: Aggregates next departures from all transit stops within radius of coordinates.

scenarios.name: Live Station Board Near Coordinates
scenarios.description: Fetch upcoming departures around Amsterdam Centraal station coordinates.

apis.summary: Next departures from a specific stop
apis.description: Live upcoming departures from a single stop with route short names, destinations, and scheduled times.

scenarios.name: Next Departures for Stop 2992191
scenarios.description: Upcoming departures from Amsterdam Centraal platform 2992191.

apis.summary: Next departures for both forward and reverse directions
apis.description: Retrieves next departures grouped by direction (inbound / outbound) for a stop.

scenarios.name: Bidirectional Departures at Stop 2992191
scenarios.description: Fetch upcoming departures in both travel directions.

apis.summary: Single or bulk trip lookup via query parameter
apis.description: Lookup trip metadata (route_id, service_id, headsign, direction_id) by trip IDs.

scenarios.name: Trip Information Lookup
scenarios.description: Lookup details for a specific trip ID.

apis.summary: Stop-by-stop timetable for a trip
apis.description: Full itinerary of a trip: all calling stops, scheduled arrival times, and departure times in chronological order.

scenarios.name: Complete Stop Times for Trip 1
scenarios.description: View scheduled stops and arrival times for trip ID 1.

apis.summary: List all GTFS shape identifiers
apis.description: Returns list of all distinct shape IDs and point counts in the active database.

scenarios.name: Browse Available Shape IDs
scenarios.description: Fetch first 10 shape records.

apis.summary: Shape geometries connecting two stops
apis.description: Finds route shapes that travel between a specified origin stop and destination stop.

scenarios.name: Find Route Shape Between Two Stations
scenarios.description: Query shape connecting two stop IDs.

apis.summary: List all transit operators/agencies
apis.description: Returns all transit agencies (NS, Arriva, Connexxion, GVB, Keolis, etc.) along with the total number of routes each agency operates.

scenarios.name: List Operators in Active Database
scenarios.description: Get all transit agencies and their route counts in the Netherlands GTFS database.

apis.summary: Detailed profile for an agency
apis.description: Returns agency name, official website URL, timezone, language, and customer phone number.

scenarios.name: Inspect Agency Profile (NS)
scenarios.description: Retrieve contact details and website for Nederlandse Spoorwegen (IFF:ns).

apis.summary: Routes operated by an agency
apis.description: Returns all bus/train/transit lines operated by a specific agency.

scenarios.name: Routes Operated by NS
scenarios.description: Fetch top 5 lines operated by NS.

apis.summary: Stops served by an agency
apis.description: Returns all physical stations and stops called by an agency's trips.

scenarios.name: Stations Served by NS
scenarios.description: Fetch top 5 stations called by NS trains.

apis.summary: Realtime background poller health & feed state
apis.description: Returns health status of background poller, leader election status, active feed timestamps, and total cached entity counts (trips, vehicles, alerts).

scenarios.name: Check Realtime System Health & Feeds Freshness
scenarios.description: Verify background feed polling status, HTTP response codes, and ETag cache status.

apis.summary: Active live trip updates and delays
apis.description: Paginated list of all active GTFS-RT trip updates, delays (in seconds), platform reassignments, and cancellations.

scenarios.name: Fetch Latest Active Delays
scenarios.description: Retrieve 10 current live trip delay updates across the network.

apis.summary: Live GPS coordinates of transit vehicles
apis.description: Returns current GPS latitude/longitude, bearing, speed, and occupancy status of active vehicles on the map.

scenarios.name: Live Vehicle Map Tracking
scenarios.description: Fetch live positions of 20 active transit vehicles for map visualization.

apis.summary: Live service alerts and disruptions
apis.description: Returns active disruptions, track maintenance, cancellations, and causes across routes and stations.

scenarios.name: View Active Network Disruptions
scenarios.description: Check for current service advisories and track work announcements.

apis.summary: Live realtime feed for a single route
apis.description: Aggregates live trip updates, moving vehicle positions, and relevant service alerts for a specific line.

scenarios.name: Live Tracking for Route 17803
scenarios.description: Fetch real-time delays, active vehicles, and alerts for route 17803.

apis.summary: Live departures and alerts for a stop
apis.description: Real-time departure board for a physical stop including live delays and platform changes.

scenarios.name: Live Departure Board at Stop 2992191
scenarios.description: Live departure board with delay seconds at Amsterdam Centraal.

apis.summary: High-level database entity statistics
apis.description: Returns counts of routes, stops, trips, calendar service days, and agencies in the active database.

scenarios.name: Database Overview Stats
scenarios.description: Inspect total numbers across the transit network.

apis.summary: Quick route and stop counts
apis.description: Fast count of total routes and stops without loading full tables.

scenarios.name: Quick Count
scenarios.description: Retrieve total route and stop counts.

apis.summary: Point-to-point journey planner between stops
apis.description: Finds direct routes and departure options connecting origin stop and destination stop.

scenarios.name: Plan Journey Between Two Stations
scenarios.description: Find direct connection options between two stops.

apis.summary: GTFS to OpenStreetMap stop matching
apis.description: Returns matched GTFS stop and OSM node pairs with matched distances.

scenarios.name: View Matched GTFS and OSM Stops
scenarios.description: Fetch 10 matched GTFS-OSM stop mappings.
